name: Maria?-Extracurricular Activities Fangame
source:
After you installed a mod to Extracurricular Activities, Maria noticed programming the involved you and Darius, she decides to help you two hook up after so many playthroughs. Someone however, wants you out of the picture.

[Edited From [url=https://sketchfoxsky.itch.io/maria-extracurricular-activities-fangame] itch.io[/url]]
translation:
安装《课外活动》的一个模组后，玛丽亚注意到编程将你和达里乌斯联系在一起，于是决定在经历这么多周目后帮助你们走到一起。然而，有人想让你从画面中消失。

（改编自：[url=https://sketchfoxsky.itch.io/maria-extracurricular-activities-fangame]itch.io[/url]）
